semantic_contract.failure_scope: 监听器、路由组、路由池和完整 Provider/interface/model/key 身份共同持有连续交付失败计数，独立于当前请求的重试预算和 Provider 健康状态。
semantic_contract.failure_transition: 每次实际派发的唯一失败结果只计数一次。第四次连续失败原子地清除该成员的所有旧 session 绑定、执行挂起或队尾迁移并更新成员代次。提前结束请求内重试不触发队列迁移。
semantic_contract.success_transition: 当前代次已接受的业务成功清零失败计数；只有最新 session 选择的成功结果可以更新绑定。取消和发送前本地失败不计数。
semantic_contract.release_transition: 释放挂起成员更新代次并进入队尾，不恢复旧绑定、不清除健康冷却；旧代次结果不能撤销释放。
semantic_contract.control_transport: Admin resolves a Server-owned endpoint record keyed by canonical config and server id, connects only to its loopback SocketAddr with redirects and proxies disabled, and sends the listener-scoped control command. The Server keeps loopback peer authorization for both business-listener controls and its optional companion, which exposes no business endpoints.
semantic_contract.control_state: Status is read-only. Release validates the exact listener, route group, pool and complete identity. Persist only when release changes the durable held set; return persistence errors explicitly.
semantic_contract.control_lifecycle: Bind a specific non-loopback listener's companion on IPv4 loopback port zero. Publish its typed address record only after serving is ready. On partial startup, shutdown, exec close or drop, stop owned tasks/sockets and remove only a record that still names this owner's endpoint. Control failure leaves business listeners serving and reports control unavailability.
